description: End-of-day US options chains since January 2010 for 5,800+ underlyings (stocks, ETFs and indexes, delisted included): every strike and expiry each day with last, bid, ask, bid and ask implied volatility, open interest, volume, delta, gamma, vega, theta and rho. Give symbol and day (YYYY-MM-DD; default the latest day); optional expiry (YYYY-MM-DD) and right (C or P) narrow the chain. Clipped to as_of. Free keys get the last 12 months; FinzData Options EOD gives the full history: one underlying $49, Magnificent 7 + SPY + QQQ $495, every underlying $2,950 (https://finzdata.com/options-eod-data).

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

day.description: Trading day YYYY-MM-DD; default the latest day.

name: get_options_eod
title: Get end-of-day options chains
